name: Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil 6.76 fl.oz, 200ml | Gentle Oil Cleanser for Face, Korean Facial Cleanser, Double Cleansing
description:
Centella Light Cleansing Oil

- A lightweight, oil-based cleanser that gently melts away makeup, dirt, oils and sunscreen without stinging the eye area

- Centella oil (MCT-oil-extracted Centella) and 6 botanical oils

- Micellar cleansing oil allows removal of excess oil and makeup without removing healthy oils

- Water-like light texture, suitable for those who are new to oil cleansers

- Non-comedogenic and dissolves sebum to prevent pore congestion
